correctness.rationale: The continuous-time velocity order is reconstructed via ordered OU differences and a one-sided Skorokhod regulator; the all-rate Laplace response follows by a killed OU/backward mixed-boundary resolvent and exact renewal identity. The scalar threshold equation is derived from the first two unreset moments, has a single interior passive root of nonzero slope, and yields sequential coefficients −1 and 4L²/(125D) using resolvent limits. All 1,226 finite independent checks in verify.py passed. No claim of uniqueness of persistence crossover or a finite-activity global boundary is made.

value.rationale: For the self-review, higher reset propulsion velocity delays absolute absorption at all activity strengths and reset rates, whereas the location separating beneficial from harmful weak-rate resetting moves in opposite directions when persistence changes. The explicit opposite coefficients and integral formula provide a physically motivated testable phase-boundary mechanism absent from center-zero velocity theory, without inflated claims of a full finite-activity phase diagram.
